title: 49ers to put WR De'Zhaun Stribling on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers to put WR De'Zhaun Stribling on injured reserve
sources.description: 49ers rookie wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling will miss at least four games due to the ankle injury he suffered in last Thursday's season-opening win over the Rams.
